title: Claim a private-monorepo ROADMAP item before building it
problem: Parallel ventures runs on bet #1 read the same payapps ROADMAP 'Next' list and pick the same item. The duplicate check (open PRs at start) cannot see a PR opened or merged minutes later, so whole slices are built twice and closed.
evidence: 2026-11-25: private-monorepo PRs 106 (merged), 107 and 108 (closed) all built 'Weekly email, part 3: the member's own time zone and hour' within about 20 minutes; run record prompts/runs/2026-11-25-session_01XpHqydVFvCareni32JhLEe.json
change: A claim step for private roadmap items, like security_next.py --claim: push an empty-tree branch `claim/<app>/<item-slug>` to private-monorepo (fails if taken), listed by a small script that ventures runs call before choosing; or have allocate.py print claimed items. Document it in cloud-session.md, 'Reaching private-monorepo'.
metric: Closed-unmerged duplicate PRs in private-monorepo per week
baseline: 2 closed duplicates of one item on 2026-11-25 (PRs 107, 108)
